limitations: Only stationary centered spatial covariance is isotropic at the critical rate; the full stationary density need not be. The model omits anisotropic mobility, partial or renewal resetting, and finite-data inference.
scientific_integrity: Stationary generator identities are proved for independent isotropic translation noise, constant intrinsic chirality, positive propulsion and angular diffusivity, and complete Poisson position-and-heading resetting. No independent audit is claimed.
title: Universal covariance-isotropy point in a reset chiral active Brownian particle
